query: How does VoyageFlow handle hotels and flights?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow provides hotel recommendations based on user preferences and generates deep booking links to partner platforms such as Booking.com, Expedia, and Agoda [voyageflow-overview::002]. For flights, it generates search links pre-filled with origin, destination, and dates, with supported partners including Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak [voyageflow-overview::002]. Users complete the actual booking for both hotels and flights on the partner site, as VoyageFlow does not act as a travel agent, an Online Travel Agency (OTA), or a merchant of record [voyageflow-overview::002]. VoyageFlow does not store real-time seat availability [voyageflow-overview::002] or display live prices [booking-policies::003]. It encourages users to verify current prices, cancellation policies, room details, and total costs on the partner platform before finalizing any booking [booking-policies::003]. While VoyageFlow generates booking links with date-specific considerations pre-filled, final pricing and availability must be confirmed on partner platforms [tokyo-spring-guide::004].
